Y_LOWER = 1.92  # Lower sieve: small vs medium
Y_UPPER = 2.52  # Upper sieve: medium vs large

GAP_UPPER = 0.24  # Gap to allow medium particles (0.14-0.24m diameter), blocks large

DENSITY = 75.0  # Density to stay under 75 kg total

    beam_width = (x_total - (beam_count - 1) * GAP_LOWER) / beam_count
    beam_width = max(0.08, min(beam_width, 1.0))  # Clamp to valid range

    x_start = BUILD_ZONE_X[0]
    x_total = BUILD_ZONE_X[1] - x_start

        sandbox.set_material_properties(beam, restitution=0.0)
        bodies.append(beam)
    
    # Add vertical support beams to improve structural stability
    # These will help prevent displacement from sweeper forces
    if len(bodies) < 6:
        # Left vertical support
        beam = sandbox.add_static_beam(
            x=BUILD_ZONE_X[0] + 0.1,
            y=(Y_LOWER + Y_UPPER) / 2,
            width=0.08,
            height=Y_UPPER - Y_LOWER,

        )

        bodies.append(beam)
